rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Basic Conditions of Employment Act and a sectoral determination for domestic work.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain
rules.n: National minimum wage applies in full since 2022.

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura

rules.v: Normal hours limited as for other workers
rules.vi: Jam kerja normal dibatasi seperti pekerja lain

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
rules.vi: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Work visas tied to the employer.

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen

rules.v: Inspection of households allowed under stated safeguards
rules.vi: Pengawasan rumah tangga diizinkan dengan pengaman yang ditetapkan
rules.n: Inspectors may enter a private home with consent or a court order.

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya

rules.v: Included in the general social security system, including maternity
rules.vi: Termasuk dalam sistem jaminan sosial umum, termasuk kehamilan
rules.n: Unemployment insurance since 2003; work-injury compensation since 2020.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.n: C190 ratified; Protection from Harassment Act.

rules.v: May form and join trade unions
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat

decisions.nm: Discovery Health Ltd v. CCMA and Others
decisions.pe: A foreign worker in South Africa was dismissed after his work permit ran out. The employer said he could not complain because he had no permit. The Labour Court said he was still an employee and could bring his case.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja asing di Afrika Selatan dipecat setelah izin kerjanya habis. Majikan berkata ia tidak bisa menggugat karena tidak punya izin. Pengadilan Ketenagakerjaan menyatakan ia tetap pekerja dan boleh mengajukan perkaranya.

decisions.nm: Larbi-Odam and Others v. MEC for Education (North-West Province)
decisions.pe: Teachers from other African countries were told they could not hold permanent jobs because they were not South African citizens. The Constitutional Court said this was unfair discrimination and opened the posts to permanent residents.
decisions.pi: Guru-guru dari negara Afrika lain diberi tahu bahwa mereka tidak boleh menjadi guru tetap karena bukan warga Afrika Selatan. Mahkamah Konstitusi menyatakan ini diskriminasi yang tidak adil dan membuka jabatan itu bagi penduduk tetap.

decisions.nm: Minister of Home Affairs v. Watchenuka
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.pe: South Africa banned asylum seekers from working or studying while they waited, sometimes for years. The appeal court said a blanket ban breaks the right to dignity.
decisions.pi: Afrika Selatan melarang pencari suaka bekerja atau belajar selama menunggu, kadang bertahun-tahun. Pengadilan banding menyatakan larangan menyeluruh melanggar hak atas martabat.

decisions.nm: Somali Association of South Africa v. Limpopo Department of Economic Development
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.pe: Police closed hundreds of small shops run by Somali and Ethiopian traders in Limpopo. The court said refugees may get trading licences, and asylum seekers too when they have no other way to earn a living.
decisions.pi: Polisi menutup ratusan toko kecil milik pedagang Somalia dan Etiopia di Limpopo. Pengadilan menyatakan pengungsi boleh mendapat izin dagang, begitu pula pencari suaka jika tidak punya cara lain mencari nafkah.

decisions.nm: Khosa v. Minister of Social Development
decisions.pe: Mozambicans who were permanent residents in South Africa were denied pensions and child grants because they were not citizens. The Constitutional Court said they must be included.
decisions.pi: Warga Mozambik yang menjadi penduduk tetap di Afrika Selatan ditolak pensiun dan tunjangan anak karena bukan warga negara. MK menyatakan mereka harus diikutsertakan.

decisions.nm: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.pe: People held for deportation in South Africa could be kept for weeks without seeing a judge. The Constitutional Court said they must appear before a court within 48 hours.
decisions.pi: Orang yang ditahan untuk dideportasi di Afrika Selatan bisa ditahan berminggu-minggu tanpa bertemu hakim. MK menyatakan mereka harus dihadapkan ke pengadilan dalam 48 jam.

decisions.nm: Mahlangu v. Minister of Labour
decisions.pe: A domestic worker drowned in her employer’s pool and her family got nothing because the law left out domestic workers. The Constitutional Court said that was discrimination. The ruling covers many migrant domestic workers too.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga tenggelam di kolam renang majikan dan keluarganya tidak mendapat apa-apa karena UU tidak mencakup pekerja rumah tangga. MK menyatakan itu diskriminasi. Putusan ini juga melindungi banyak pekerja rumah tangga migran.

decisions.nm: Union of Refugee Women v. Director, Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority
decisions.pe: Refugee women who wanted to work as security guards were refused because they were not citizens or permanent residents. The Constitutional Court, by majority, let the rule stand.
decisions.pi: Perempuan pengungsi yang ingin bekerja sebagai petugas keamanan ditolak karena bukan warga negara atau penduduk tetap. MK, dengan suara terbanyak, mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.nm: Saidi v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.pe: Asylum seekers whose claims were refused lost their papers while they challenged the refusal in court, so they could be arrested or lose their jobs. The court said the papers must stay valid until the case ends.
decisions.pi: Pencari suaka yang permohonannya ditolak kehilangan dokumen selama menggugat penolakan itu, sehingga bisa ditangkap atau kehilangan pekerjaan. Pengadilan menyatakan dokumen harus tetap berlaku sampai perkara selesai.

decisions.nm: Ruta v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.pe: A Rwandan man arrested for being in South Africa without papers said he feared going home. The court said he must be allowed to claim asylum first, even though he had waited.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria Rwanda yang ditangkap karena berada di Afrika Selatan tanpa dokumen mengaku takut pulang. Pengadilan menyatakan ia harus diberi kesempatan mengajukan suaka dulu, meski sudah menunda.

decisions.nm: Minister of Home Affairs v. Scalabrini Centre (Cape Town reception office)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.pe: The government stopped accepting new asylum applications in Cape Town, so people had to travel far to apply. The appeal court said the closure was unlawful and ordered the office to reopen.
decisions.pi: Pemerintah berhenti menerima permohonan suaka baru di Cape Town sehingga orang harus bepergian jauh untuk mendaftar. Pengadilan banding menyatakan penutupan itu tidak sah dan memerintahkan kantor dibuka kembali.

decisions.nm: Nandutu v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.pe: Foreign husbands and wives of South Africans had to leave the country to switch from a visitor visa to a spouse visa. The Constitutional Court said they may apply without leaving.
decisions.pi: Suami atau istri asing warga Afrika Selatan harus keluar negeri untuk mengganti visa kunjungan menjadi visa pasangan. MK menyatakan mereka boleh mengajukan tanpa keluar.

decisions.nm: Dawood v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.pe: Foreign spouses of South Africans were refused permits to stay while their residence applications were decided, with no rules for officials to follow. The Constitutional Court said this breached the right to family life.
decisions.pi: Pasangan asing warga Afrika Selatan ditolak izin tinggal selama permohonan izin tetapnya diproses, tanpa aturan bagi petugas. MK menyatakan ini melanggar hak atas kehidupan keluarga.

decisions.nm: Abore v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.pe: An Ethiopian man was arrested for being in South Africa without papers and said he wanted asylum. The Constitutional Court said he must be released to apply.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria Etiopia ditangkap karena berada di Afrika Selatan tanpa dokumen dan menyatakan ingin mencari suaka. MK menyatakan ia harus dibebaskan untuk mengajukannya.

decisions.nm: Scalabrini Centre v. Minister of Home Affairs (abandonment rules)
decisions.pe: A 2020 change in South Africa’s law said that asylum seekers who missed a renewal date had abandoned their claim and could be deported. The Constitutional Court struck this down.
decisions.pi: Perubahan UU Afrika Selatan pada 2020 menyatakan pencari suaka yang terlambat memperpanjang izin dianggap meninggalkan permohonannya dan bisa dideportasi. MK membatalkannya.

decisions.nm: Helen Suzman Foundation v. Minister of Home Affairs (Zimbabwean Exemption Permits)
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa, Gauteng Division
decisions.pe: Many Zimbabweans had lived and worked in South Africa for over ten years on special permits. The government decided to end them. The High Court said this was unlawful without a fair process.
decisions.pi: Banyak warga Zimbabwe tinggal dan bekerja di Afrika Selatan lebih dari sepuluh tahun dengan izin khusus. Pemerintah memutuskan mengakhirinya. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah tanpa proses yang adil.

decisions.nm: Bula v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.pe: Ethiopian men held in a deportation centre said they wanted asylum. The appeal court said they must be released and allowed to apply.
decisions.pi: Pria Etiopia yang ditahan di pusat deportasi menyatakan ingin mencari suaka. Pengadilan banding menyatakan mereka harus dibebaskan dan diizinkan mengajukan.

decisions.nm: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs (detention at ports of entry)
decisions.pe: People stopped at South African airports and harbours could be held without the protections other detainees have. The Constitutional Court said the same protections apply to them.
decisions.pi: Orang yang dihentikan di bandara dan pelabuhan Afrika Selatan bisa ditahan tanpa perlindungan yang dimiliki tahanan lain. MK menyatakan perlindungan yang sama berlaku bagi mereka.

decisions.nm: Mohamed v. President of the Republic of South Africa
decisions.pe: A Tanzanian man was quickly sent from South Africa to the United States to stand trial for an embassy bombing. The Constitutional Court said this was unlawful without a promise that he would not be executed.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria Tanzania segera dikirim dari Afrika Selatan ke Amerika Serikat untuk diadili atas pengeboman kedutaan. MK menyatakan ini tidak sah tanpa janji ia tidak akan dihukum mati.

decisions.nm: Rafoneke v. Minister of Justice and Correctional Services
decisions.pe: Law graduates from Lesotho and Zimbabwe who studied in South Africa could not be admitted as lawyers because they were not citizens or permanent residents. The Constitutional Court let the rule stand.
decisions.pi: Lulusan hukum dari Lesotho dan Zimbabwe yang belajar di Afrika Selatan tidak bisa diangkat sebagai pengacara karena bukan warga negara atau penduduk tetap. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.nm: Kiliko v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa, Cape Provincial Division
decisions.pe: Access to refugee reception offices for asylum seekers queuing for months.
decisions.pi: Akses pencari suaka ke kantor penerimaan pengungsi setelah antre berbulan-bulan.

decisions.nm: Tantoush v. Refugee Appeal Board
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa, Transvaal Provincial Division
decisions.pe: Review of a refused refugee claim by a Libyan applicant.
decisions.pi: Peninjauan penolakan permohonan pengungsi seorang pemohon Libya.

decisions.nm: Arse v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.pe: Release of an asylum seeker held beyond the lawful period.
decisions.pi: Pembebasan pencari suaka yang ditahan melebihi batas sah.

decisions.nm: Abdi v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.pe: Somali asylum seekers held at an airport inadmissible facility.
decisions.pi: Pencari suaka Somalia ditahan di fasilitas tolak masuk di bandara.

decisions.nm: Kaunda v. President of the Republic of South Africa
decisions.pe: Diplomatic protection for South Africans detained abroad.
decisions.pi: Perlindungan diplomatik bagi warga Afrika Selatan yang ditahan di luar negeri.

decisions.nm: Director-General, Department of Home Affairs v. Mukhamadiva
decisions.pe: Detention of foreign nationals and the urgency of court orders for release.
decisions.pi: Penahanan warga asing dan mendesaknya perintah pengadilan untuk pembebasan.

decisions.nm: Ahmed v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.pe: Whether asylum seekers may apply for other visas from within the country.
decisions.pi: Apakah pencari suaka boleh mengajukan visa lain dari dalam negeri.

decisions.nm: Ashebo v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.pe: Detention of a person who intends to apply for asylum.
decisions.pi: Penahanan orang yang berniat mengajukan suaka.

decisions.nm: Koyabe v. Minister for Home Affairs
decisions.pe: Exhausting internal remedies before going to court over an immigration decision.
decisions.pi: Menempuh upaya internal sebelum menggugat keputusan imigrasi ke pengadilan.

decisions.nm: Jeebhai v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.pe: Lawfulness of detention and deportation of a foreign national.
decisions.pi: Keabsahan penahanan dan deportasi warga asing.

decisions.nm: Rahim v. Minister of Home Affairs
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
decisions.pe: Damages for unlawful immigration detention.
decisions.pi: Ganti rugi atas penahanan imigrasi yang tidak sah.

decisions.nm: Jaga v. Donges and Another; Bhana v. Donges and Another
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Validity of immigration restrictions applied to Indian residents of South Africa (historical Immigration Act case).
decisions.pi: Keabsahan pembatasan imigrasi terhadap penduduk keturunan India di Afrika Selatan (perkara UU Imigrasi lama).

decisions.nm: K E v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Immigration Act matter involving a foreign national and the Minister of Home Affairs.
decisions.pi: Perkara UU Imigrasi antara seorang warga asing dan Menteri Dalam Negeri.

decisions.nm: Buthelezi and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Immigration-related claim against the Minister of Home Affairs under the Immigration Act.
decisions.pi: Gugatan terkait imigrasi terhadap Menteri Dalam Negeri berdasarkan UU Imigrasi.

decisions.nm: Minister of Home Affairs v. A R
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Whether a foreign national who did not apply for asylum on arrival can later access the asylum system.
decisions.pi: Apakah warga asing yang tidak mengajukan suaka saat tiba masih bisa masuk sistem suaka kemudian.

decisions.nm: Director-General, Department of Home Affairs and Others v. A I and Another
decisions.pe: Constitutional challenge to Refugees Act amendments on abandonment of asylum applications.
decisions.pi: Uji konstitusional atas perubahan UU Pengungsi tentang permohonan suaka yang dianggap ditinggalkan.

decisions.nm: A I and Another v. Director of Asylum Seeker Management: Department of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Refugees Act provisions treating asylum applications as abandoned when permits lapse.
decisions.pi: Ketentuan UU Pengungsi yang menganggap permohonan suaka ditinggalkan bila izinnya kedaluwarsa.

decisions.nm: L K v. Chairperson Standing Committee for Refugee Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa KwaZulu-Natal, Durban
decisions.pe: Review of a refugee status decision by the Standing Committee for Refugee Affairs.
decisions.pi: Peninjauan keputusan status pengungsi oleh Komite Tetap Urusan Pengungsi.

decisions.nm: Director-General: The Department of Home Affairs and Others v. Dekoba
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Refugee reception office access and the time an asylum seeker has to report after entry.
decisions.pi: Akses ke kantor penerimaan pengungsi dan batas waktu pencari suaka melapor setelah masuk.

decisions.nm: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Somali Association of South Africa Eastern Cape
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Closure of the Port Elizabeth refugee reception office and its effect on asylum seekers.
decisions.pi: Penutupan kantor penerimaan pengungsi Port Elizabeth dan dampaknya bagi pencari suaka.

decisions.nm: Asanbeng v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa South Gauteng, Johannesburg
decisions.pe: Immigration Act matter concerning a foreign national and the Minister of Home Affairs.
decisions.pi: Perkara UU Imigrasi tentang seorang warga asing dan Menteri Dalam Negeri.

decisions.nm: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
decisions.pe: Scalabrini Centre litigation against the Minister of Home Affairs concerning asylum seekers.
decisions.pi: Gugatan Scalabrini Centre terhadap Menteri Dalam Negeri mengenai pencari suaka.

decisions.nm: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
decisions.pe: Challenge to Home Affairs regulations affecting asylum seekers (Scalabrini Centre).
decisions.pi: Gugatan atas peraturan Kementerian Dalam Negeri yang berdampak pada pencari suaka (Scalabrini Centre).

decisions.nm: Road Accident Fund v. Mudawo and Others; Road Accident Fund v. Lyton and Others
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Road Accident Fund claims brought by foreign nationals.
decisions.pi: Klaim Dana Kecelakaan Lalu Lintas yang diajukan warga asing.

decisions.nm: Booysen and Others v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
decisions.pe: Work permits and residence rights of foreign spouses of South African citizens.
decisions.pi: Izin kerja dan hak tinggal pasangan asing warga negara Afrika Selatan.

decisions.nm: Tsebe and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa South Gauteng, Johannesburg
decisions.pe: Extradition or deportation of a Botswana national facing the death penalty.
decisions.pi: Ekstradisi atau deportasi warga Botswana yang terancam hukuman mati.

decisions.nm: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Tsebe and Others, Minister of Justice and Constitutional Development and Another v. Tsebe and Others
decisions.pe: Deportation or extradition of foreign nationals to a state where they face the death penalty.
decisions.pi: Deportasi atau ekstradisi warga asing ke negara tempat mereka terancam hukuman mati.

decisions.nm: Helen Suzman Foundation and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another (All Truck Drivers Forum intervening)
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa North Gauteng, Pretoria
decisions.pe: Termination of the Zimbabwean Exemption Permit program.
decisions.pi: Penghentian program Zimbabwean Exemption Permit.

decisions.nm: City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality v. Unknown Protesters/Refugees and Others
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa North Gauteng, Pretoria
decisions.pe: Eviction application against refugees and protesters camping in Pretoria.
decisions.pi: Permohonan pengusiran pengungsi dan pengunjuk rasa yang berkemah di Pretoria.

decisions.nm: H H v. Chairperson of Refugee Appeal Board and Others
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
decisions.pe: Review of a Refugee Appeal Board decision on an asylum claim.
decisions.pi: Peninjauan keputusan Dewan Banding Pengungsi atas permohonan suaka.

decisions.nm: Ulde v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Lawfulness of detention at Lindela repatriation centre beyond the period allowed by the Immigration Act.
decisions.pi: Keabsahan penahanan di pusat repatriasi Lindela melebihi jangka waktu menurut UU Imigrasi.

decisions.nm: Malachi v. Cape Dance Academy International (Pty) Ltd and Others
decisions.pe: Imprisonment of a Malawian employee for debt on suspicion of flight (arrest to found jurisdiction).
decisions.pi: Pemenjaraan pekerja asal Malawi karena utang atas dugaan akan kabur (penangkapan untuk menetapkan yurisdiksi).

decisions.nm: S v. Qurashi and Others
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Criminal appeal in a human trafficking prosecution concerning exploitation of trafficked persons.
decisions.pi: Banding pidana dalam penuntutan perdagangan orang atas eksploitasi korban.

decisions.nm: Centre for Child Law v. Director General Department of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.pe: Birth registration of children born in South Africa to foreign parents.
decisions.pi: Pencatatan kelahiran anak yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua asing.

decisions.nm: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.pe: Constitutional challenge by Scalabrini Centre concerning Home Affairs rules affecting asylum seekers and migrants.
decisions.pi: Uji konstitusional oleh Scalabrini Centre atas aturan Kementerian Dalam Negeri yang berdampak pada pencari suaka dan migran.

decisions.nm: Mulowayi and Others v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
decisions.pe: Citizenship claim by a person born in South Africa to foreign parents under the Citizenship Act.
decisions.pi: Klaim kewarganegaraan orang yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua asing berdasarkan UU Kewarganegaraan.

decisions.nm: Democratic Alliance v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
decisions.pe: Automatic loss of South African citizenship on acquiring another nationality (section 6(1)(a) Citizenship Act).
decisions.pi: Hilangnya kewarganegaraan Afrika Selatan secara otomatis saat memperoleh kewarganegaraan lain (pasal 6(1)(a) UU Kewarganegaraan).

decisions.nm: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Jose and Another
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Citizenship by birth for children born in South Africa to non-citizen parents.
decisions.pi: Kewarganegaraan berdasarkan kelahiran bagi anak yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua bukan warga negara.

decisions.nm: Chisuse and Others v. Director-General, Department of Home Affairs and Another
decisions.pe: Citizenship by descent for persons born abroad to a South African parent.
decisions.pi: Kewarganegaraan berdasarkan keturunan bagi orang yang lahir di luar negeri dari orang tua warga Afrika Selatan.

decisions.nm: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa North Gauteng, Pretoria
decisions.pe: Detention of foreign nationals beyond permitted periods (Lawyers for Human Rights).
decisions.pi: Penahanan warga asing melebihi jangka waktu yang diizinkan (Lawyers for Human Rights).

decisions.nm: Ex parte: Minister of Home Affairs and Another v. Lawyers for Human Rights; In Re: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.pe: Extension of a declaration of invalidity on immigration detention provisions (section 34 Immigration Act).
decisions.pi: Perpanjangan pernyataan tidak sah atas ketentuan penahanan imigrasi (pasal 34 UU Imigrasi).

decisions.nm: Saidi and Others v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.ct: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
decisions.pe: Extension of asylum seeker permits pending judicial review.
decisions.pi: Perpanjangan izin pencari suaka selama menunggu peninjauan yudisial.

decisions.nm: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Johnson and Others; Minister of Home Affairs and Another v. Delorie and Others
decisions.pe: Immigration and visa matter involving foreign nationals and the Minister of Home Affairs.
decisions.pi: Perkara imigrasi dan visa yang melibatkan warga asing dan Menteri Dalam Negeri.

decisions.nm: Somali Association of South Africa and Others v. Refugee Appeal Board and Others
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Validity of Refugee Appeal Board decisions taken by a single member.
decisions.pi: Keabsahan keputusan Dewan Banding Pengungsi yang diambil oleh satu anggota.

decisions.nm: Refugee Appeal Board of South Africa and Others v. Mukungubila
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
decisions.pe: Refugee status decision concerning a political asylum seeker from the DRC.
decisions.pi: Keputusan status pengungsi bagi pencari suaka politik dari RD Kongo.

decisions.nm: GD v Minister of Home Affairs and Others
decisions.pe: Subject to be confirmed from the judgment.
